correctness.rationale: All \(120^3\) ordered profiles are exhaustively evaluated. An independent anonymous-profile enumeration over \(\binom{122}{3}\) multisets with exact weights agrees entrywise. All \(2^{10}\) labeled tournaments are separately quotiented under \(S_5\), giving 12 classes; the public verifier reproduces every number and returns VERIFY_OK.

evidence: Eggermont–Hurkens–Woeginger prove every tournament on at most seven vertices has a three-permutation realization and report infeasible isomorphism types only for eight and nine vertices.
Shepardson–Tovey prove every tournament on seven or fewer vertices has predictability 2/3 or 1.
broader_coverage.reasoning: These results imply nonzero fibers but do not determine the number of profiles in any fiber, so they do not imply the stated distribution.

value.rationale: The result refines a natural realizability question to the complete probability mass function on tournament isomorphism types for the smallest nontrivial odd electorate at five alternatives. It gives exact structural information, not merely a witness or a recomputation of the number of tournament classes.
